description: The routing edge this component exists for: an acquittal, which KRS 17.142(4) most often sends to KRS 431.076 instead — so the correct outcome of this component is to route the participant AWAY from this track and produce neither instrument. Also exercises the no-charges-filed branch and an empty agency list.

chargeData.chargeDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF WHAT THEY WERE ARRESTED FOR]
chargeData.arrestOffenceDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF WHAT THEY WERE ARRESTED FOR]

screeningAnswers.segOffence: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION — NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE]
screeningAnswers.segDispositionType: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN STATEMENT OF FACT — found innocent — NOT SUPPLIED, DERIVED OR INFERRED BY LEGALEASE]
screeningAnswers.segAlreadyExpunged: participant states they may be eligible under KRS 431.076

eligibilityData.expectedRoutingOutcomeNote: The correct outcome here is that neither instrument is produced. KRS 17.142(4) sends records subject to KRS 431.076 to that statute instead, expungement is materially stronger, and a participant who may be eligible under KRS 431.076 or KRS 431.078 is a self-help stop condition. This component's job on this fixture is to stop the route, not to advance it.
eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted in either direction: the component does not conclude that KRS 431.076 applies, only that the participant's own answer requires that question to be resolved before anything is produced.
boundaryUnderTest: KRS 17.142(4) routing edge: an acquittal, the disposition most likely to belong under KRS 431.076 instead.
segAlreadyExpunged reports possible eligibility elsewhere — the gate that must suppress both instrument components.
segChargesFiled = no: no case number, and the court-route venue would be the court where the matter would have been tried.
segAgencies empty: the agency-letter component cannot be produced at all, since it exists only per identified agency.
segRoute unanswered: no instrument may be selected before the routing question is resolved.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config (Movant on the void-and-seal tracks, Applicant on the KRS 17.142(2) application), not by the fixture key name.
